newsitem.title: USA: CME SEPT LUMBER SHARPLY LOWER AS LONGS LIQUIDATE.
newsitem.headline: CME SEPT LUMBER SHARPLY LOWER AS LONGS LIQUIDATE.

text.p: CME September lumber futures fell sharply on long liquidation and concern about weakness in the cash market, floor sources said.
They noted R.B. and H. Financial Services and Prudential Securities were noted sellers of September.

Traders said lumber production continued to outpace demand and there was talk that prices in the cash market were weakening. At 1045 CDT September lumber stood $8.50 per thousand board feet lower at $353.00.
